dimensions.stop_if: authorization, containment, weather, or human takeover is unresolved
a sensitive period or complaint threshold is exceeded
the task energy ceiling is exceeded
accessible movement or ordinary logistics is displaced
quiet, school, event, or recovery windows conflict

rules: Hard authorization and safety gates run before optimization.
Emergency priority does not waive identity, human takeover, audit, or recovery.
No single operator may consume more than one third of a cell-window in the synthetic test.
A rejected or ground-transferred request remains a successful control outcome when it matches the declared stop rule.
Every decision can be appealed and replayed by a named human reviewer.
units_note: 0-100 normalized design-test tokens; not physical or statutory units.
